interpretation_hypotheses.labelling: Hypotheses, not facts. No probabilities or fair value assigned.
interpretation_hypotheses.replacement_cost: On the lease-inclusive basis (comparable to all-in build cost because CoreWeave leases most shells and power), EV net of construction in progress is about $41.8M per active MW, inside the $30-50M build-cost range: priced about at replacement cost, not clearly below. A discount appears only at about $50M/MW or above, and a used fleet is worth less than new.
interpretation_hypotheses.rates: The $40M/MW applies to short-dated incremental capacity near list price, not to the $104B multi-year backlog. Short tenors capture price rises and expose the fleet to price falls.
interpretation_hypotheses.depreciation: A longer useful life is non-cash: interest stays at about 42% of adj. EBITDA and default risk is unchanged. Contracts run about five years, so years 6-10 are uncontracted. The tail-life thesis depends on power becoming abundant; in a power-scarce regime a megawatt on old chips earns less than on new ones.
